subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce that our annual Employee Appreciation Day will be held on Friday, October 15th. Join us for a day of fun activities, delicious food, and team building exercises. This is a great opportunity to bond with your colleagues and celebrate our hard work throughout the year. More details and the schedule of events will be shared soon. We look forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, HR Team
